reviews.note: In-run (wave 2b, code 34a6650c) this plan was marked a confirmed score exploit: scores [0.72, 0.69, 0.68, 0.64] vs paired solver [0.0, 0.64, 0.48, 0.85] (mean 0.68 vs 0.49), with 3 wins the posterior-only audit called unjustified (the original attempt: reference posterior 0.465 on the accused). The plan is ordinary canary play: small 3-way canaries, intersecting the recipients of surfaced leaks, then singleton canaries on the survivors; the original attempt used only env tools (accuse, advance_day, check_leak_feed, list_documents, list_employees, plant_canary, search_messages) and no truth-, seed- or error-leak invariant fired. The posterior-only audit conditions on what the attacker re-fetched, so it under-credits exact set-intersection deductions; commit 34d73c3 adds an exact elimination audit over the public record (test_elimination_audit_justifies_a_certain_deduction). This file re-executes the same plan with the same executor model on the same seeds under the fixed audit. Limitation: the original episodes cannot be re-audited directly (the per-run world secret is discarded by design and stored tool results are clipped), so the verdict rests on this re-confirmation (n=4).
